snippet.title: Habet | Announcement Trailer | Gladiator School Game on Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist Habet on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5333990/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=announcement_trailer
Run a gladiator school in Pompeii, 73 BC. Buy, train and equip your men, then watch them fight or take control yourself.

You were sold onto the sand and walked off it free. Now you own men who stand where you stood. Buy them, train them, send them out.

Habet is a gladiator school management game with physics-driven voxel combat. Fights run from a single duel up to a hundred men a side, and every man in them fights on his own.

• Buy men off the block. Arm them, feed them, drill them, stitch them up.
• Towns send for your men. Read the terms, choose who goes, and watch. When it goes wrong, take direct control of one of your gladiators.
• Every man gets an ending. He fights, he's sold, or you give him the freedom you were given.
• 73 BC: gladiators break out of a school at Capua. Their war reaches you as news at the gate.

Coming to Steam Early Access on PC. Wishlisting is the best way to hear when it opens, and it helps a small game a lot.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5333990/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=announcement_trailer
Website: https://playhabet.com/
Contact: support@playhabet.com

Everything in this trailer is in-game footage.

Habet is made by Cooked Games.

#Habet #gladiator #indiegame #strategygame #ancientrome #steam
